description: Find the police force and neighbourhood policing team for a point, or look one up by force and neighbourhood id. Returns the team's description, contact channels and police stations, its current priorities with the action taken, team members' ranks and names, and upcoming engagement events. include adds the boundary polygon, needed only to split a neighbourhood too large to search into smaller polygons: ukcrime_search_crimes, ukcrime_search_outcomes and ukcrime_search_stops take the neighbourhood directly through area 'neighbourhood'.

force.description: Force id such as 'leicestershire', or its name such as 'Leicestershire Police' (ukcrime_list_reference topic 'forces' lists both), to look up by id (with neighbourhood_id); case-insensitive, spaces, underscores and hyphens match each other, '&' matches 'and', and a trailing 'Police', 'Police Service' or 'Constabulary' is optional.

include.description: Optional sections to load: 'priorities', 'team', 'events', 'boundary'. Omitted: priorities, team and events. [] loads none of them.

lat.description: Latitude, WGS84 decimal degrees, to look up by point (with lng).

lng.description: Longitude, WGS84 decimal degrees, to look up by point (with lat).

neighbourhood_id.description: Neighbourhood id from ukcrime_list_reference topic 'neighbourhoods', to look up by id (with force). Case-sensitive; only trimmed.

name: ukcrime_find_neighbourhood

attribution.description: Open Government Licence attribution for data.police.uk data.

boundary.description: The neighbourhood boundary; present when include has 'boundary' and it loaded.

polygon.description: The boundary as 'lat,lng:lat,lng:…' at 6 dp, the form the search tools' polygon takes. The first vertex repeats last.

vertex_count.description: Vertices in the polygon as returned.

data_note.description: What these records can and cannot say; read it before drawing conclusions.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_lookup`: neither or both of lat+lng and force+neighbourhood_id are given, or half of a pair. `unknown_force`: force matches no listed force id or name, or more than one, or is 'btp' (British Transport Police has no neighbourhoods). `rate_limited`: data.police.uk is rate-limiting this server for longer than this call can wait. `pacer_shed`: too many requests to data.police.uk are already queued in this server. `upstream_unavailable`: data.police.uk is not answering. `retry_deadline_exceeded`: data.police.uk did not answer within the time one call allows. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

events.description: Every upcoming engagement event the force published, soonest first and undated last; present when include has 'events' and they loaded.

events_total.description: Upcoming events published; every one is in events.

force.description: The police force the neighbourhood belongs to, as published.

id.description: Force id the other tools take as force, such as 'leicestershire'.

found.description: True when data.police.uk holds a neighbourhood team for the point or id.

gaps.description: The force's known coverage gaps, each ending with the date the table was verified.

guidance.description: Why nothing was found and what to try instead; present when found is false.

located_from.description: The point looked up, for a point lookup.

neighbourhood.description: The neighbourhood policing team and its public channels, as the force publishes them; an optional field is absent when unpublished, and all text is force-written.

contact.description: Team-level contact channels; empty when none.

channel.description: Channel, such as email, telephone or facebook.

description.description: The team or area description, as plain text.

id.description: Neighbourhood id; pass it with force as neighbourhood_id to the search tools' area 'neighbourhood'.

links.description: Links the force publishes for the team; empty when none.

items.description: One link the force publishes for the team.

population.description: Resident population; absent when given as 0.

stations.description: Police stations and bases listed for the team; empty when none.

items.description: One police station or base the team works from.

url.description: The team's page on the force website.

notice.description: Parts that could not be loaded from data.police.uk, and how to retry.

priorities.description: The team's current priorities, force-written; present when include has 'priorities' and they loaded.

issue_date.description: When it was set, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS (no time zone).

team.description: Team members' ranks and names; present when include has 'team' and they loaded.

items.description: One team member, as the force publishes them.

rank.description: Rank; can include a collar number.

title: Find UK Police Neighbourhood
